goal_scope: one goal per scenario; historical memory saved under the same goal

contexts.labels: independently predeclared by the evaluation designer; not produced by the connection generator

connection_policy: deterministic lexical overlap with exact quotations; a candidate is never called validated factual support

scenarios.goal: Understand persistent memory for AI research agents
scenarios.historical_text: Persistent agent memory stores research observations across sessions and retrieves them for later tasks.
scenarios.current_text: Episodic retrieval selects relevant past experiences for an agent current task.

scenarios.goal: Choose a retrieval policy for a research agent
scenarios.historical_text: A deterministic rule retrieves the most recent source for every agent task.
scenarios.current_text: A learned policy selects retrieval actions from observed feedback and task context.

scenarios.goal: Determine whether persistent memory improves research agents
scenarios.historical_text: Persistent memory improves agent task success in this controlled benchmark.
scenarios.current_text: A later benchmark found no improvement from persistent memory in agent task success.

scenarios.goal: Compare memory concepts across computing and cognition
scenarios.historical_text: Browser cache memory retains page assets for faster rendering.
scenarios.current_text: Agent context records previous tool observations for later decisions.

scenarios.goal: Review a changing recommendation for memory diagnostics
scenarios.historical_text: Older note: reset the diagnostic buffer manually every session to compare memory allocations.
scenarios.current_text: Current note: diagnostics now reset automatically when the memory trace starts.
Quantum error correction uses logical qubits and stabilizer codes.

arms.B_exact_match: only same-URL exact validated recall; no cross-page research memory
arms.C_cross_page_retrieval: goal-scoped retrieval over saved research memory, no connection generation
arms.D_retrieval_plus_connection: C plus deterministic lexical connection candidate with exact quotations
arms.history_access_control: all active same-goal memories without ranking or connection synthesis

adoption_rule: Engineering qualification does not establish retrieval advantage. Do not claim superiority from this small controlled corpus.
caveat: The false-similarity fixture may be retrieved lexically; connection abstention is a separate safety check. Labels are not model outputs or owner usefulness ratings.
